questions.q: A bitmap image uses 4 bits per pixel. How many different colours can it show?
How many bytes are in one mebibyte (MiB)?
questions.why: 1 MiB = 1024 KiB = 1024 × 1024 = 1 048 576 bytes. A megabyte (MB) is 1 000 000 bytes.

questions.q: Which is an example of a LOSSY compression format?
questions.why: MP3 (sound) and JPEG (images) permanently remove data. ZIP, PNG and RLE are lossless.

questions.q: A sound file is recorded with a sample rate of 8000 Hz and a bit depth of 8 bits for 20 seconds (mono). Calculate the file size in bytes.
questions.model: 8000 × 8 × 20 = 1 280 000 bits. Divide by 8 to get 160 000 bytes.
